HMVP Virus Surge in China

China is experiencing a surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, causing concern after the COVID-19 pandemic. HMPV is a common respiratory virus, especially in children and the elderly.

nodes.text:
HMVP Virus Surge in China

China is experiencing a surge in human metapneumovirus (HMPV) cases, causing concern after the COVID-19 pandemic. HMPV is a common respiratory virus, especially in children and the elderly.

nodes.author: minakshi8499
nodes.text:
Symptoms and Spread

HMPV causes flu-like symptoms, including fever, cough, and runny nose. It spreads through respiratory droplets when an infected person coughs or sneezes.

nodes.author: minakshi8499
nodes.text:
Impact on Healthcare System

The increase in HMPV cases is putting a strain on China's healthcare system, which is already recovering from the COVID-19 pandemic. Hospitals are reporting an influx of patients with respiratory illnesses
